scope: Append-only route-gated loader successor for GitHub's own public-loader lineage. No GitLab loader bytes are imported.
boundaries: GitHub and GitLab have distinct site-loader lineages and are reviewed independently.
The GitHub successor is admissible only if the current branch loader equals the GitHub main predecessor followed by exact_append.
The module renders only when the current normalized route appears in its source-controlled route data.
Branch/PR creation does not establish public deployment or a merits finding.
